truong-vocab-set-17: Truong vocabulary practice words from set 17.

column3: A person who belongs to a country and has rights and responsibilities there
column7: A citizen can vote when they are old enough and help their community.

column3: A group of people who live, learn, work, or share something together
column7: Our school community worked together to clean the playground.

column3: To give or add something to help a group
column7: Each family will contribute food for the picnic.
Cooperation helped the group finish the mural.

column3: A form of government in which people have a say, often by voting for leaders
column7: In a democracy, people can vote to choose leaders.

column3: A process where people vote to choose leaders
column7: The election results were announced after lunch.

column3: Having the same rights, chances, or treatment
column7: Equality means everyone should have the same right to learn.

column3: Treating people in a reasonable and just way
column7: Fairness means following the same rules and listening to everyone.

column3: The system and people that make decisions and laws for a community, state, or country
column7: Local government helps manage roads, parks, and other public services.

column3: Fair treatment, including using laws to protect rights and respond to wrongdoing
column7: The class discussed how rules can help create justice and fairness.

column3: A rule made by a government that people must follow
column7: A law says drivers must stop at red lights.

column3: The ability to guide or influence others
column7: Leadership means guiding others with care.

column3: To take part in an activity
column7: I participate by joining the class discussion.

column3: To stand for something or to speak or act for someone else
column7: The stars on a map can represent state capitals.

column3: To show care and consideration for someone or something
column7: We show respect by listening quietly.

column3: Freedoms and protections that people are entitled to have
column7: The right to be treated fairly is an important protection.

column3: Work done to help others or a community
column7: The food drive was a service to the community.

column3: To offer to help without being paid
column7: Liam will volunteer at the animal shelter.
